name: 检测（在线/脱机/激光）反馈

map.选择检测方式(在线/脱机/激光)，输入实测尺寸与理论值，计算偏差并判定IT公差等: Select inspection mode (online/offline/laser), input measured size and nominal value, compute deviation and judge the IT tolerance grade
map.本工具按 CNC 加工尺寸检测规范，输入实测尺寸与理论值计算偏差并对照 IT 公: Per CNC machining dimensional inspection practice, this tool inputs measured and nominal sizes, computes deviation, judges pass/fail against IT tolerance grades, and gives tool-compensation and machining-adjustment suggestions; fully client-side, no data uploaded.
map.比选在线、脱机与激光检测反馈方式。: Compare online, offline and laser inspection feedback modes.
map.评估检测方式对生产节拍与质量闭环的影响。: Assess how inspection mode affects production takt and quality closed-loop.
map.为过程质量控制方案选型。: Select a scheme for process-quality control.
map.在线检测可实时反馈并自动剔除不良品，适合大批量稳定工序，但需平衡节拍与误报率。: Online inspection gives real-time feedback and auto-rejects bad parts, suited to high-volume stable processes, but must balance takt and false-alarm rate.
map.激光测量非接触、速度快，适合易变形或高温工件，但受表面反射率影响需校准。: Laser measurement is non-contact and fast, suited to easily-deformed or high-temperature workpieces, but is affected by surface reflectivity and needs calibration.
map.在线与脱机如何取舍？: How to choose online vs offline?
map.关键尺寸与高不良率工序用在线；离线复检与仲裁用脱机，二者常组合使用。: Use online for critical dimensions and high-defect-rate processes; use offline for re-inspection and arbitration; the two are often combined.
map.激光测量要注意什么？: What to watch in laser measurement?
map.工件表面颜色、粗糙度与反光会影响精度，需做标定并避开强环境光。: Workpiece surface color, roughness and reflectivity affect accuracy; calibrate and avoid strong ambient light.
map.在线检测使用机床测头，实时反馈但精度较低(±5μm)；脱机检测精度最高(±2μm: Online inspection uses a machine probe, real-time feedback but lower accuracy (+/-5um); offline inspection has the highest accuracy (+/-2um)
map.激光检测适合复杂曲面和薄壁件，但测量不确定度较大(±10μm): Laser inspection suits complex curved surfaces and thin-wall parts, but has larger measurement uncertainty (+/-10um)
map.公差等级按GB/T 1800.1标准，IT01最高，IT18最低: Tolerance grades follow GB/T 1800.1; IT01 is the highest, IT18 the lowest
map.测量不确定度应小于公差带的1/3~1/10，否则判定结果不可靠: Measurement uncertainty should be less than 1/3 to 1/10 of the tolerance band, otherwise the judgment is unreliable
map.偏差占公差带百分比可反映加工过程能力，建议控制在30-70%: The deviation as a percentage of the tolerance band reflects process capability; keep it within 30-70%
map.CNC加工尺寸检测反馈工具，支持在线/脱机/激光三种检测方式，计算尺寸偏差、判定: CNC machining dimensional inspection feedback tool supporting online/offline/laser modes, computing size deviation, judging IT tolerance grade and giving machining-adjustment suggestions.
map.偏差自动计算与公差判定: Automatic deviation calculation and tolerance judgment
